### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized, standard Windows desktop).
*   **Top Title Bar (0, 0 - 1024, 40):** Contains app icon/title (left) and window controls (right).
*   **Navigation/Toolbar Cluster (0, 41 - 1024, 115):**
    *   Left: Navigation buttons (Home, Back, Forward), Current Path display ("Pictures").
    *   Right: View toggle, Filter button, Search input.
*   **Main Content Area (0, 116 - 1024, 855):** Split into three vertical panes.
    *   **Tree Pane (Left) (0, 116 - 280, 855):** File type categories list.
    *   **File List Pane (Center) (281, 116 - 795, 855):** Grid view of file types/folders.
    *   **Preview/Details Pane (Right) (796, 116 - 1024, 855):** Selected item details and actions.
*   **Bottom Status Bar / CTA Area (0, 856 - 1024, 950):**
    *   Left: Status message with icon.
    *   Right: Primary action button ("Recover All...").
*   **Windows Taskbar (0, 951 - 1024, 768):** Standard OS taskbar at the bottom.

### 2. TEXT
*   **Title Bar:** "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free"
*   **Toolbar:** "Pictures", "Filter", "Search files or folders"
*   **Tabs:** "Path", "Type"
*   **File List Header:** "Select All"
*   **Tree Pane Items:**
    *   "Pictures" | "140.1K"
    *   "Videos" | "6.4K"
    *   "Documents" | "411.1K"
    *   "Audio" | "16.0K"
    *   "Archives" | "159.3K"
    *   "Emails" | "12"
    *   "Bookmarks"
    *   "Others" | "406.3K"
    *   "Unsaved Files"
*   **File List Items (Labels):** "jpg", "png", "jpeg", "gif", "tif", "eps", "bmp", "ico", "ani"
*   **Preview Pane:**
    *   "jpg"
    *   "Open"
    *   "Size"
    *   "50.85 MB"
    *   "Path"
    *   "C:\"
*   **Bottom Bar:**
    *   "Scan Completed, Files Found: **1139250** (149.73 GB)"
    *   "Recover All ..."
*   **Taskbar:** "Search", "4:56 PM", "10/17/2026"

### 3. COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window/App Background: `#F5F7FA` (Light Blue-Grey)
    *   Tree/List Item Hover/Selected: `#E6F0FF` (Light Blue)
    *   Preview Pane Background: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Selected Item Border: `#2B7FFF` (Bright Blue)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Names): `#333333` (Dark Grey)
    *   Secondary Text (Counts/Metadata): `#888888` or `#999999` (Grey)
    *   Link/Accent Text: `#2B7FFF` (Blue - e.g., "Type" tab, "Open" button text)
*   **Accents/Controls:**
    *   Primary Button (Recover): `#2875E6` (Blue)
    *   Secondary Button (Open): `#E6F0FF` background, `#2875E6` text.
    *   Checkbox Border: `#CCCCCC` -> Checked: `#2875E6`.
    *   Scrollbar Thumb: `#D0D5DD`.

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Font Family:** Segoe UI (Standard Windows).
*   **Title Bar:** 12px, Regular.
*   **Toolbar/Breadcrumbs:** 14px, Regular.
*   **Tab Headers ("Path", "Type"):** 13px, Medium (Selected is Blue).
*   **Tree Pane Items:** 13px, Regular (Name), 12px Regular (Count, right-aligned).
*   **File Labels ("jpg", etc.):** 13px, Regular, Centered.
*   **Status Bar Message:** 14px, Regular.
*   **Button Text:** 14px, Medium.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Grid:** File icons are approx 100x100px cards with ~16px gap (gutter).
*   **Row Heights:**
    *   Tree Pane Rows: ~36px.
    *   Toolbar Height: ~50px.
    *   Tab Bar Height: ~40px.
*   **Paddings:**
    *   Tree Item Indent: ~20px per level.
    *   Card Padding: ~10px around icon.
    *   Content Margins: ~15-20px from window edges.
*   **Radii:**
    *   Buttons: 4px - 6px.
    *   Search Box / Cards: 4px.
    *   Checkboxes: 2px (slightly rounded square).
*   **Stroke Widths:**
    *   Borders (Cards/Panes): 1px.
    *   Icons (Outline): 1.5px - 2px.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Window Controls:** Minimize, Maximize, Close (Top Right).
*   **Nav Buttons:** Home (Icon), Back (Disabled/Greyed out), Forward (Disabled/Greyed out).
*   **View Toggle:** Icon button (Grid view active).
*   **Filter:** Text Button with Icon ("Filter").
*   **Search:** Input field with magnifying glass icon (right aligned).
*   **Tabs:** "Path" (Normal), "Type" (Selected/Active - Blue text, bold implicit).
*   **Tree View:**
    *   Expand/Collapse arrows (Chevron right/down).
    *   Checkboxes (Square).
    *   **State:** "Pictures" node is Expanded and Selected (Blue highlight). "Videos", "Documents", "Audio", "Archives", "Emails" are Collapsed. "Bookmarks", "Others", "Unsaved Files" are Collapsed.
*   **File List (Grid):**
    *   Checkboxes on each item.
    *   **State:** First item ("jpg") is Focused/Selected (Blue border). Others are Normal.
*   **Preview Pane:**
    *   "Open" button (Secondary style).
*   **Bottom Bar:**
    *   "Recover All ..." button (Primary style, Blue).
    *   Status Indicator (Checkmark in circle).

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, filled (mostly), with slight gradients/shadows for depth (Material-ish or modern Fluent style).
*   **Types:**
    *   **Folder Icons:** Light blue folder graphic, consistent across all items.
    *   **Category Icons:** Distinct colored squares with symbols inside (e.g., Picture=Mountain, Video=Play button, Document=Page, Audio=Note).
    *   **UI Icons:** Outline stroke style (Home, Arrows, Filter Funnel, Grid dots, Search Mag glass).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Success / Data Populated**. The scan has finished ("Scan Completed"), and results are displayed.
*   **Selection State:** The "Pictures" category is selected in the tree. The "jpg" file type is selected in the grid. The preview pane reflects this selection.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot). No loading spinners present.
